text: The monthly pizza was such a fun idea, and this month's combination was honestly amazing. You can tell they actually care about making good pizza instead of just throwing ingredients together.
name: Jake

text: I'm usually all about the toppings, but the crust completely stole the show. Crispy, slightly charred, and somehow still super fluffy. Absolutely delicious.
name: Lucy

text: I've tried a lot of pizza places, but Sliced&Toasted has definitely made it into my regular rotation. Everything tastes fresh, the pizzas are full of flavor, and the whole place has such a good vibe.
name: Robert

text: The pizza was incredible. The crust had that perfect crispy edge but was still soft in the middle, and the toppings tasted really fresh. Definitely coming back.
name: Jackeline

text: There's something about this place that just feels different. The food is great, the people are genuinely nice, and you can tell there's a lot of love behind what they're doing.
name: Sam

text: I came for a quick dinner and ended up staying way longer than planned. The pizza was fantastic, the atmosphere was really welcoming, and obviously we had to finish with one more slice.
name: Ruth
